status: Proposed; requires explicit owner/semantic adoption before production implementation

laws.proposal: Retain immutable original assessment and actual declared/member types; views must not rewrite them.
laws.guard: Existing native assessment/PSVI remains independently retained; full real-provider cases required.

laws.proposal: Carry authority only with the selected original value through variables, containers, function identity and reordering.
laws.guard: Do not reconstruct authority from equal lexical/value contents or QName/digest caches.

laws.proposal: Obtain actual typed values from admitted provider facts; retain actual member type and original assessment source where issued.
laws.guard: No typed value, nilled empty value and empty/singleton list metadata remain distinct.

laws.proposal: The result has the requested current type; do not inherit the input assessment claim automatically, even for same-type/equal-value casts.
laws.guard: Original node/assessment is unchanged. A user-defined target type needs its own authority-backed operation/fact; a numeric conversion alone cannot issue one.

laws.proposal: Arithmetic, comparisons and string computation do not automatically inherit input assessment authority.
laws.guard: If audit lineage is needed, keep it separate, optional and non-authorizing; do not allocate unbounded per-item histories.

laws.proposal: Provenance must not alter XPath comparison/hash/map-key semantics.
laws.guard: Canonicalized/reconstructed keys cannot claim an incompatible input type. CLR default equality still needs an explicit separate disposition.

laws.proposal: Keep provenance only for the representative actually retained unchanged under the language rules.
laws.guard: Never combine authorities merely because values compare equal.

laws.proposal: Preserve or strip state explicitly; accepted directional views retain original PSVI.
laws.guard: Deep materialization does not imply resource detachment; changed content requires strip/reassessment/refusal.

laws.proposal: Serialize a representation, not live authority, session or lease ownership.
laws.guard: Restore semantic currentness and authority through explicit trusted admission; diagnostic IDs cannot self-authenticate.

laws.proposal: A retained provenance object or cached scalar is not a resource lease.
laws.guard: Provider dereference uses the original live owner; cached metadata may remain readable after closure.
